subject: Request: Proof of key ownership + access log extract for BluePeak SIG
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepeak.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Security <security@bluepeak.io>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: key ownership + access logs for SIG review

Hi Kimberly,

As part of our SIG assessment for the BluePeak integration, we need a short bundle proving: (1) who currently has ownership/administrative access to the tenant KMS keys used for BluePeak tenant encryption, (2) an exported access log slice covering key management operations (Create/Rotate/Disable/Export wrap keys) for the last 90 days, and (3) HSM attestation / firmware version for any customer-managed keys.

Can you provide an access_log extract (CSV), a concise statement of key ownership + approval workflow, and any HSM attestation artifacts you can share? We don't need raw keys. A single-threaded reply with attachments (or a secure link) is perfect.

Target deadline for our SIG submission: Friday, 17 May COB. Let me know if that timeline is feasible.

Thanks,
Sarah
Security Operations, BluePeak

[BluePeak customer id: BP-4417]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: key ownership + access logs for SIG review

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide what you requested. Quick plan:
- Marissa will prepare the access_log_export CSV scoped to key-management API events for BP-4417 (Create, Rotate, Disable, Wrap/Unwrap requests) covering the last 90 days.
- I'll provide a short ownership statement that lists the administrative roles that can approve key rotation/creation and the approval workflow.
- Irene will supply HSM attestation and firmware details for the HSM cluster that hosts customer-managed keys.

We expect to deliver the initial bundle by EOD Thu (16 May). If you need anything earlier or different filters (specific user IDs, IP ranges), let me know.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment placeholder: none yet]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: key ownership + access logs for SIG review

Hi all,

Attached is the exported access_log slice for the BluePeak tenant (BP-4417) covering 2029-02-14 through 2029-05-14. The export contains event timestamps (UTC), event_type, actor_id, actor_role, method, resource_id (key ID), operation_result, source_ip, and request_id. We redacted ephemeral session tokens and replaced userids with hashed identifiers where allowed by the NDA.

Attachment: access_log_export_20290514.csv (CSV, 2.1MB)

Notes on filtering and integrity:
- Exported directly from the immutable audit pipeline (WORM store) with a signed manifest.
- Events for system-initiated automated rotations include the operator service account (svc-key-rotator) in the actor_role field.
- We included the request_id for cross-correlation with our telemetry if you need raw logs.

Kimberly, I'll hand the signed manifest and sha256 digest in the final package.

-Marissa
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access_log_export_20290514.csv]
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepeak.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, BluePeak Security <security@bluepeak.io>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 11:10:00 -0700

Thanks Marissa — this looks helpful. A couple of quick follow-ups:
1) Can you confirm the key wrapping algorithm(s) used (RSA-OAEP-256, AES-KW, etc.) for tenant wrapping keys?
2) For rotation events, can you indicate whether rotations were automated vs manual approval (we saw svc-key-rotator and a few hashed userids).
3) Do you have the HSM cluster firmware build and FIPS module version? We need the exact build strings for the SIG evidence.

If easier, we can take those as short bullets in a reply rather than another file.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sarah

On Wed, May 15, 2029 at 08:27 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is the exported access_log slice for the BluePeak tenant (BP-4417) covering 2029-02-14 through 2029-05-14. ...
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepeak.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: key ownership + access logs for SIG review

Hi Sarah, Kimberly, Marissa —

Below are concise answers you can include in the SIG packet. I also attached the HSM attestation (PEM) and the rotation report PDF with per-key timeline.

1) Key wrapping algorithms: our tenant-level key wrapping uses AES-KW (RFC 3394) for symmetric KEKs and RSA-OAEP-256 for asymmetric wrapping when customers request BYOK (customer-supplied RSA keys). We store algorithm metadata in the key manifest and include algorithm names in the access_log resource_type field.

2) Rotation attribution: rotations are categorized in the export by actor_role. Events performed by svc-key-rotator are automated scheduled rotations according to the tenant's rotation policy. Events where actor_role == "admin" reflect manual rotations approved through the Key Change Request workflow (two approver rule). The rotation report contains a per-event "approval_type" column (automated/manual) and references the approval ticket ids.

3) HSM cluster/fips/firmware: attached is the HSM attestation PEM and the signed manifest. Current HSM firmware: Thales nShield v5.6.3-build-2028-11-02; FIPS module: 140-2 Level 3 (certificate CN=FIPS-140-2-Module-12345). The attestation also lists the HSM serial ranges that host the wrapped KEKs for BP-4417.

Deliverables attached:
- kms_key_rotation_report_20290516.pdf (summary + per-key timeline + approval ids)
- hsm_attestation_20290516.pem (signed attestation from HSM cluster owner)

If you need the approval ticket links or want the full, unredacted audit export under an executed DPA amendment, we can escalate through Legal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to review the artifacts together before submission.

Irene Choi
Manager, Applied Cryptography & Ops
Redwood Inference
